source.report: Reporte agrometeorológico de impactos, 26 mayo–1 junio 2026

extraction: Indexed PDF text via public web search/open; source PDF direct download and visual inspection unavailable during assembly
important_flags: Narrative says Mallares; table says Tinajones. Variety unresolved.
Dates are phase/event onset as tabulated, not harvest date.
Reported climate numbers in PDF rows should not be interpreted as NASA POWER daily series.
No exact field parcel polygon or direct crop geolocation is established.
No genotype-specific calibration; FAO-56 Kc stages are not equivalent to botanical phases.
